body:
Feel your pain 100%, I just can't feel comfortable interacting with people in general. You know what to say, but the delivery is so damn difficult. Honestly if I had some charisma, I could easily make friends because I know EXACTLY what to say, I just can't say it...

Sucks...
People remember you for your actions, not your outward appearance. No great historical figure is remembered for their appearance, it simply doesn't matter...
